title: Remove the shipped Markdown and browser Provider implementations
summary: Hard-delete the two concrete Provider packages and their Host runtime adapter. The platform keeps only generic Provider contracts and registries; requests requiring an unavailable capability fail closed. Implementation evidence: this change landed in b5921f9, the commit that added this record, and remains in force at 66e7e45; b5921f9 was pushed without a recorded Verification run, so the record is carried as implemented rather than verified. Its 'provider-package-absence' acceptance item no longer holds because packages/assayer-provider-markdown was restored by restore-markdown-audit-slice, while the browser-provider removal stands. The record is deliberately kept implemented rather than superseded: its surviving 'tests/**' changedPath is the only design authorization covering 38 of the 65 tests/*.py files that no other approved record lists, so moving it to superseded would drop that coverage.

platform: generic Provider contracts, registry, negotiation, and execution boundary
fail-closed behavior when no installed Provider supplies a requested capability
distribution and runtime assembly without concrete Provider packages
plugin: input and check declarations in compiled-plugin.json
provider: future independently installed capability implementations conforming to the Provider contract
agent: interpret evidence and submit decisions after a Provider is available

forbiddenResponsibilities: importing assayer_document_navigation or assayer_browser_provider from platform code
built-in Markdown parser or browser snapshot implementation
compatibility aliases for the removed Provider packages

humanApproval.decision: Approved for hard-cut removal of both concrete Providers without compatibility adapters.
